items.rule: The product and brand in prose. Capital P, no "PICO", no "Pico AI" as a bare name
The company and project name. Domain: picofinds.com. Contact: us@picofinds.com
The Shopify App Store listing name, in full on the listing and in App Store copy. It separates Pico from "Piko ‑ Pickup Reminder"
The theme app embed's name, exactly as it appears in the Shopify theme editor
The category. Lowercase in prose
The store that installs and pays. Not "user" in copy, not "client" unless an implementer is speaking
The person asking in the widget. Never "customer" when the merchant could misread it as their own buyer list
Agencies of every kind, Shopify developers, theme developers, and freelancers. "Agency" alone excludes freelancers
An implementer accepted into the program, and one with 5 active paying stores. Only after the partner page is live in week 6
The first 20 US merchant stores. Never "beta" or "early access program"
The billing unit: a chat thread with at least one AI reply. Messages from the same shopper on the same device within 24 hours count once. Fair use: 50 AI replies
The source of every product card. Always "synced", because stock is as of the last catalog sync
Image, name, price, stock label, and a View link

items.term: Analytics page, Overview, Catalog, Integrations, Assistant, Plan & Usage, Settings
items.rule: The seven dashboard pages, capitalized as named
Request to result, click, and add to cart, with step conversion

items.term: zero result phrases, weak click phrases
items.rule: Requests to the assistant that returned no products, or products that drew few clicks
The sample outdoor gear catalog on the real API. Never "demo store" in copy
The downloadable file a coding agent follows. Never "AI installer"
How Pico reaches the storefront. Never "plugin" or "script injection" for Shopify
The usage bar on Plan & Usage
The merchant demand driver. Capitalized, never "audit"
The implementer demand driver: $150, up to 90 minutes
The service an implementer can sell from the session's findings

items.term: Shopify Store Findability Scorecard, Agency AI Shopping Readiness Scorecard
items.rule: The two ScoreApp lead magnets, named in full
A claim the reader can check now, labelled as checkable. Never presented as a customer result
The closed list of permissioned customer proof. Empty on 2026-11-04
The 10% share on stores a partner manages but did not refer, and the 90-day claim on a client store's myshopify domain
Pico positions against "another AI chatbot". Use AI shopping assistant
There is no vector search. Describe the matching
Stock is as of the last catalog sync
Pico adds to the store's own cart. Checkout stays in the store
No program name before week 6, and no certification exists
